name: image-caption
description: Local Quartz 5 transformer plugin that marks a genuine "image immediately followed by an italic caption" paragraph (![](img.png)*Caption*, nothing between them) with a dedicated class, so base.scss's caption styling can select on that instead of the `p > img + em` combinator, which also matches any later, unrelated italic phrase in the same paragraph since CSS sibling combinators ignore intervening text.

quartz.name: image-caption
quartz.description: Marks genuine image captions (an <em> immediately after an image, nothing between them) so caption styling doesn't also catch unrelated italic text later in the same paragraph.
